# External Standard Contract Regression Fixtures

These public documents are downloaded only for local regression testing of standard-clause matching. They are not added to `match/` and therefore are not used to build the standard clause library.

| Local fixture | Publisher and source | Intended check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dongguan-housing-rental-contract.docx` | [Dongguan Administration for Market Regulation contract template page](https://dgamr.dg.gov.cn/ywgz/wljyjg/content/post_3207996.html), attachment “住房租赁合同示范文本.docx” | A full rental template should not be treated as broadly incomplete. |
| `dongguan-market-management-service-contract.docx` | [Dongguan Administration for Market Regulation contract template page](https://dgamr.dg.gov.cn/ywgz/wljyjg/content/post_3207996.html), attachment “东莞市农贸市场管理服务合同（范本）.docx” | A focused service template may legitimately retain partial and missing items. |
| `shanghai-affordable-rental-housing-contract.pdf` | [Shanghai Housing Administration and Market Regulation Bureau housing-rental template PDF](https://fgj.sh.gov.cn/cmsres/8c/8c1869021906415ba12a6560bd9441c0/19ad24b24312a44a25170aacd8725845.pdf) | PDF extraction and rental-template completeness regression. |

The government pages describe these as public contract demonstration texts. Source access was verified on 2026-08-29. The files remain subject to their publishers' notices and are used here only for local functional verification.
